pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-sized, irregularly polygonal patches with moderately rounded edges. The pixel gradients at the boundaries are relatively soft. Patches on the upper neck exhibit horizontal elongation compared to the more equilateral geometry of the flank patches.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the corridors remains largely uniform across the primary flank, with slight tapering observed at junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the upper neck and shoulder as a short, uniform fringe. The silhouette against the out-of-focus background shows a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated pattern consisting of individual hair bundle peaks.
